summary: The reworked percentile() now matches DESIGN-001: p validation (bool/float/str rejected, 1..100), empty-list ValueError, sorted copy, integer rank -(-p*N//100), index r-1. Hand-evaluating all 12 unit test specs against the code gives the expected values, including the five that failed in R00010 (TEST-001/002/010/011/012). The fix stayed within fix_scope and the tests are unchanged.

checklist.item: Code matches design contract (signature, errors, boundaries)
checklist.note: Signature identical; ValueError for non-int/bool/out-of-range p and for empty scores; p=1/100, N=1, p*N multiple of 100, p=29 N=100 all handled by integer ceil.

checklist.item: No unrequested behaviour / dead code / unsafe code
checklist.note: Single pure function, no I/O, no leftover code from the faulty implementation.

checklist.item: Each unit TEST spec implemented by a test named with TEST_nnn
checklist.note: TEST_001..TEST_012 all present; TEST_001 has an extra parametrized test covering the request examples (superset, fine).

checklist.item: Assertions meaningful, nothing skipped or swallowed
checklist.note: Concrete expected values; pytest.raises(ValueError) for every abnormal case incl. True and 50.0; TEST_003 checks the list is unchanged.
No conftest; tests import the function directly.
No change-requests.json; the defect lists no test changes and tests match tests.json.

checklist.item: DEFECT-001 root cause explains every failing case and fix within fix_scope
checklist.note: Old floor/no-minus-one logic explains all 5 failures (35 vs 20, 3.5 vs 2.5, 30 vs 29, 9 vs 5); unlinked_failing_tests is empty; only src/scorestats/percentile.py changed besides defects.json status. G5 shows STALE results from the old code, which the validator must re-run.

findings.description: Validation order checks p before scores; both give ValueError, so the contract is unaffected. Non-numeric elements are not validated, which the design does not require.
